Name: Guest can enter app without sign-in
Description: Verify that tapping 'Continue as Guest' launches the app and navigates directly to the event catalog without requiring any credentials or form fields.
Preconditions: App is installed and launched for the first time in a fresh session.
Test Steps (Steps): Launch the Encore app ~ App opens to the guest entry screen
Tap 'Continue as Guest' ~ No form fields or sign-in prompts are shown
Observe the resulting screen ~ Event catalog (Event List) is displayed immediately

Name: Event catalog displays all required event details
Description: Verify that each event card in the catalog shows title, category, venue, date/time, and starting price.
Preconditions: Guest has tapped 'Continue as Guest' and is on the Event List screen.
Test Steps (Steps): View the event catalog ~ A scrollable list of upcoming events is displayed
Inspect any event card ~ Event title is visible
Inspect the same event card ~ Category label is visible
Inspect the same event card ~ Venue name is visible
Inspect the same event card ~ Date and time are visible
Inspect the same event card ~ Starting price is visible

Name: Category filter chips narrow the event list
Description: Verify that selecting a category chip filters the catalog to show only events of that category, and selecting 'All' resets the full list.
Preconditions: Guest is on the Event List screen with all events visible.
Test Steps (Steps): Observe the filter chips row above the event list ~ 'All' chip and one chip per event category present in the catalog are displayed
Tap a specific category chip (e.g., 'Music') ~ Event list narrows to show only Music events
Verify no events from other categories appear ~ Only Music events are listed
Tap the 'All' chip ~ Full event catalog is restored with events from all categories

Name: Sold-out events are marked and cannot be selected
Description: Verify that events with no remaining seats display a sold-out indicator and are not tappable to proceed to event details.
Preconditions: At least one sold-out event exists in the catalog. Guest is on the Event List screen.
Test Steps (Steps): Scroll through the event catalog ~ A sold-out event is visible with a sold-out marker
Attempt to tap the sold-out event ~ No navigation to Event Details occurs; the event remains unselectable

Name: Event catalog is scrollable with 30 events across 5 categories
Description: Verify the catalog contains events across all 5 categories (Music, Theater, Comedy, Classical, Sports) and the list is scrollable.
Preconditions: Guest is on the Event List screen.
Test Steps (Steps): Scroll down through the event list ~ List scrolls smoothly and more events load into view
Check that events from all 5 categories (Music, Theater, Comedy, Classical, Sports) are present ~ At least one event per category is visible across the catalog
Tap each category chip in turn ~ Each chip returns at least one event, confirming meaningful variety per category

Name: Event Details screen shows full event information
Description: Verify that the Event Details screen displays full description, venue, date/time, and seating breakdown (Standard vs VIP counts and remaining seats).
Preconditions: Guest is on the Event List screen and at least one available event exists.
Test Steps (Steps): Tap an available event from the catalog ~ Event Details screen opens
Verify full event description is displayed ~ Description text is visible
Verify venue name is displayed ~ Venue name is shown
Verify date and time are displayed ~ Date and time are shown
Verify seating breakdown is displayed ~ Standard seat count, VIP seat count, and remaining seats for each tier are visible
Tap the proceed button to go to seat selection ~ Seat Selection screen opens

Name: Event Details screen shows correct remaining seat counts
Description: Verify that the remaining seat counts on the Event Details screen accurately reflect seats not yet booked.
Preconditions: Guest is on the Event Details screen for an event with a known number of available seats.
Test Steps (Steps): Note the remaining Standard and VIP seat counts shown on Event Details ~ Counts are displayed
Proceed to Seat Selection ~ Seat map is shown
Count the available (unbooked) Standard and VIP seats on the map ~ Available seat count matches the counts shown on Event Details

Name: Seat map displays tier, price, and availability at a glance
Description: Verify that each seat on the seat map clearly shows its tier (Standard/VIP), price, and availability status (available, booked, or selected).
Preconditions: Guest has navigated from Event Details to the Seat Selection screen.
Test Steps (Steps): View the seat map ~ Seats are grouped by row
Inspect an available seat ~ Tier (Standard or VIP) and price are visible; seat appears selectable
Inspect an already-booked seat ~ Seat is visually distinct (e.g., greyed out) and not selectable
Tap an available seat ~ Seat changes to a 'selected' visual state

Name: Guest can select up to 10 seats in a single booking
Description: Verify that a guest can select a maximum of 10 seats and is prevented from selecting an 11th seat.
Preconditions: Guest is on the Seat Selection screen for an event with more than 10 available seats.
Test Steps (Steps): Tap 10 available seats one by one ~ Each seat transitions to selected state; 10 seats are selected
Attempt to tap an 11th available seat ~ Selection is blocked; an error or limit message is displayed
Verify the 10 previously selected seats remain selected ~ No previously selected seat is deselected automatically

Name: Guest can deselect a previously selected seat
Description: Verify that tapping a selected seat deselects it and returns it to the available state.
Preconditions: Guest is on the Seat Selection screen with at least one seat already selected.
Test Steps (Steps): Tap a seat that is currently selected ~ Seat returns to the available (unselected) visual state
Verify the seat count decreases by one ~ Selection count updates correctly

Name: Already-booked seats cannot be selected
Description: Verify that seats marked as already booked are not selectable by the guest.
Preconditions: Guest is on the Seat Selection screen for an event where at least one seat is already booked.
Test Steps (Steps): Identify a seat marked as already booked ~ Seat is visually distinct from available seats
Tap the booked seat ~ No selection occurs; seat state does not change
Verify no error or navigation is triggered ~ App remains on Seat Selection screen with no unintended side effects

Name: Seat booked by one guest is unavailable to another guest
Description: Verify that once a seat is booked in one session, it no longer appears as available to a guest browsing the same event in a different session.
Preconditions: Two separate guest sessions are open. Session A has completed a booking for a specific seat on Event X.
Test Steps (Steps): In Session B, navigate to Event X and open Seat Selection ~ Seat map is displayed
Locate the seat booked in Session A ~ The seat is shown as booked/unavailable
Attempt to tap the booked seat ~ Seat cannot be selected

Name: Valid discount code SAVE10 applies 10% off Standard seats only
Description: Verify that entering SAVE10 applies a 10% discount to Standard-tier seats and does not discount VIP-tier seats in the same booking.
Preconditions: Guest has selected at least one Standard seat and one VIP seat and is on the Discount Code screen.
Test Steps (Steps): Enter 'SAVE10' in the discount code field (any case) ~ Code is accepted
Observe the price breakdown ~ 10% discount is applied to Standard-tier seats
Verify VIP-tier seats in the same booking ~ No discount is applied to VIP seats
Proceed to Payment ~ Order total reflects the discounted Standard seat prices and full VIP seat prices

Name: Valid discount code FIRST20 applies 20% off all seats on first booking only
Description: Verify that FIRST20 gives 20% off any seat on the guest's first booking in a session, and is invalid on subsequent bookings.
Preconditions: Guest has not yet completed any booking in the current session. Guest has selected seats and is on the Discount Code screen.
Test Steps (Steps): Enter 'FIRST20' in the discount code field ~ Code is accepted
Observe the price breakdown ~ 20% discount is applied to all selected seats regardless of tier
Complete the booking ~ Booking is confirmed
Start a second booking and navigate to the Discount Code screen ~ Second booking flow is active
Enter 'FIRST20' again ~ Code is rejected with an inline error message
Verify checkout is not blocked ~ Guest can proceed to payment without the code

Name: Valid discount code WELCOME15 applies 15% off from second booking onward, once only
Description: Verify that WELCOME15 is invalid on the first booking, valid on the second booking, and invalid again after being used once.
Preconditions: Guest is in a fresh session. First booking has been completed without using WELCOME15.
Test Steps (Steps): On the first booking's Discount Code screen, enter 'WELCOME15' ~ Code is rejected with an inline error
Complete the first booking without a discount code ~ First booking confirmed
Start a second booking and navigate to the Discount Code screen ~ Second booking flow is active
Enter 'WELCOME15' ~ Code is accepted; 15% discount applied to all selected seats
Complete the second booking ~ Second booking confirmed
Start a third booking and navigate to the Discount Code screen ~ Third booking flow is active
Enter 'WELCOME15' ~ Code is rejected with an inline error; guest can proceed without it

Name: Invalid discount code shows inline error and does not block checkout
Description: Verify that entering an unrecognized discount code shows an inline error message but allows the guest to proceed to payment without the code.
Preconditions: Guest has selected seats and is on the Discount Code screen.
Test Steps (Steps): Enter an invalid code (e.g., 'BADCODE123') in the discount code field ~ Inline error message is displayed
Verify the error does not navigate away or block the screen ~ Guest remains on the Discount Code screen
Proceed to payment without correcting the code ~ Payment screen opens with no discount applied
Verify the order total reflects full seat prices ~ No unauthorized discount is applied

Name: Discount code field is case-insensitive
Description: Verify that discount codes are matched case-insensitively (e.g., 'save10', 'Save10', 'SAVE10' all apply the same discount).
Preconditions: Guest has selected at least one Standard seat and is on the Discount Code screen.
Test Steps (Steps): Enter 'save10' (all lowercase) in the discount code field ~ Code is accepted and 10% discount applied to Standard seats
Clear the code and enter 'Save10' (mixed case) ~ Code is accepted and same discount applied
Clear the code and enter 'SAVE10' (all uppercase) ~ Code is accepted and same discount applied

Name: Discount code step is optional and can be skipped
Description: Verify that a guest can proceed from the Discount Code screen to Payment without entering any code.
Preconditions: Guest has selected seats and is on the Discount Code screen.
Test Steps (Steps): Leave the discount code field empty ~ No code is entered
Tap the button to proceed to payment ~ Payment screen opens
Verify the order total shows full seat prices with no discount ~ No discount is applied

Name: Payment screen shows full order summary before confirmation
Description: Verify that the Payment screen displays every selected seat, subtotal, any applied discount, and the final order total before the guest confirms payment.
Preconditions: Guest has selected seats and optionally applied a discount code. Guest is on the Payment screen.
Test Steps (Steps): View the Payment screen ~ All selected seats are listed with their tier and individual price
Verify subtotal is displayed ~ Subtotal equals the sum of all seat prices before discount
Verify discount line is shown if a code was applied ~ Discount amount is displayed
Verify final total is displayed ~ Total equals subtotal minus any discount
Confirm the total is mathematically correct ~ Calculated total matches displayed total

Name: Confirming payment finalizes the booking and shows confirmation
Description: Verify that tapping the confirm payment button finalizes the booking and navigates to the Booking Confirmation screen.
Preconditions: Guest is on the Payment screen with seats selected and order summary visible.
Test Steps (Steps): Tap the confirm payment button ~ Payment is processed (mocked)
Verify navigation to Booking Confirmation screen ~ Confirmation screen is displayed
Verify a confirmation number is shown ~ Unique confirmation number is visible
Verify the event name is shown ~ Correct event is listed
Verify each booked seat is listed ~ All selected seats appear on the confirmation
Verify the final price paid is shown ~ Price matches the order total from the Payment screen

Name: No card details are collected during payment
Description: Verify that the mocked payment flow does not present any card number, CVV, or billing address fields.
Preconditions: Guest is on the Payment screen.
Test Steps (Steps): Inspect the Payment screen ~ No card number field is present
Verify no CVV or expiry date field is present ~ Payment screen contains only order summary and confirm button
Tap confirm ~ Payment completes without any card data entry

Name: Booked seats are removed from availability after payment
Description: Verify that seats finalized in a booking are no longer available on the seat map for the same event after payment completes.
Preconditions: Guest A has just completed a booking for specific seats on Event X.
Test Steps (Steps): As Guest B (new session), navigate to Event X and open Seat Selection ~ Seat map is displayed
Locate the seats booked by Guest A ~ Those seats are shown as booked/unavailable
Attempt to select one of those seats ~ Selection is not possible

Name: My Bookings lists all session bookings in reverse chronological order
Description: Verify that the My Bookings screen shows all bookings made in the current session, most recent first, each with event name, seats, total price, and confirmation number.
Preconditions: Guest has completed at least two bookings in the current session.
Test Steps (Steps): Navigate to the My Bookings screen ~ List of bookings is displayed
Verify the most recent booking appears first ~ Bookings are in reverse chronological order
Inspect each booking entry ~ Event name, booked seats, total price, and confirmation number are all visible
Verify the count of entries matches the number of completed bookings in the session ~ All session bookings are listed

Name: My Bookings is empty at the start of a new session
Description: Verify that My Bookings shows an empty state when no bookings have been made in the current session.
Preconditions: Guest has just started a new session and has not completed any bookings.
Test Steps (Steps): Navigate to the My Bookings screen ~ Screen is displayed
Verify no booking entries are shown ~ Empty state message or placeholder is displayed
Verify no bookings from a previous session are shown ~ List contains only current-session data

Name: My Bookings does not persist across sessions
Description: Verify that bookings from a previous session are not visible after the app is restarted in a new session.
Preconditions: Guest completed bookings in Session A. App is closed and reopened to start Session B.
Test Steps (Steps): In Session A, complete at least one booking ~ Booking appears in My Bookings
Close the app and reopen it ~ New guest entry screen is shown
Tap 'Continue as Guest' ~ Event catalog opens
Navigate to My Bookings ~ No bookings from Session A are listed; My Bookings is empty

Name: VIP seats are priced higher than Standard seats for the same event
Description: Verify that VIP-tier seats have a higher price than Standard-tier seats for the same event on both the seat map and the payment summary.
Preconditions: Guest is on the Seat Selection screen for an event that has both Standard and VIP seats available.
Test Steps (Steps): Inspect a Standard seat on the seat map ~ Standard seat price is displayed
Inspect a VIP seat on the same event's seat map ~ VIP seat price is displayed
Compare the two prices ~ VIP seat price is higher than Standard seat price
Select one Standard and one VIP seat and proceed to Payment ~ Payment summary shows VIP price greater than Standard price

Name: Venue seat map is consistent across events at the same venue
Description: Verify that two different events hosted at the same venue share the same seat map layout, with only availability differing.
Preconditions: At least two events are hosted at the same venue. Guest is on the Event List screen.
Test Steps (Steps): Navigate to Event Details for Event A at Venue X, then open Seat Selection ~ Seat map layout is displayed; note the row and seat arrangement
Go back and navigate to Event Details for Event B at Venue X, then open Seat Selection ~ Seat map layout is displayed
Compare the two seat maps ~ Row structure and seat positions are identical; only availability (booked/available) differs

Name: Event dates are always in the future relative to today
Description: Verify that all events in the catalog show future dates regardless of when the app is opened, confirming date generation is relative to today.
Preconditions: Guest is on the Event List screen.
Test Steps (Steps): View the event catalog ~ All events are listed with their dates
Check the date of every visible event ~ All event dates are in the future relative to today's date
Verify no event shows a past date ~ No historical dates appear in the catalog

Name: Selecting zero seats prevents proceeding to checkout
Description: Verify that a guest cannot proceed past Seat Selection without selecting at least one seat.
Preconditions: Guest is on the Seat Selection screen with no seats selected.
Test Steps (Steps): Attempt to proceed to the Discount Code or Payment screen without selecting any seat ~ Proceed action is disabled or an error message is shown
Verify the guest remains on the Seat Selection screen ~ No navigation to the next step occurs

Name: Discount applied per seat in a multi-seat booking
Description: Verify that when a discount code applies to only some seat tiers, the discount is calculated per eligible seat and the total reflects the correct mixed pricing.
Preconditions: Guest has selected 2 Standard seats and 2 VIP seats. Guest is on the Discount Code screen.
Test Steps (Steps): Enter 'SAVE10' ~ Code is accepted
Proceed to Payment ~ Payment summary is displayed
Verify each Standard seat shows a 10% reduction ~ Standard seat prices are discounted
Verify each VIP seat shows full price ~ VIP seat prices are not discounted
Verify the order total equals (discounted Standard seats × 2) + (full VIP seats × 2) ~ Total is mathematically correct

Name: App is accessible with screen reader on guest entry screen
Description: Verify that the guest entry screen is navigable using a screen reader and all interactive elements have accessible labels.
Preconditions: Screen reader (TalkBack/VoiceOver) is enabled on the device. App is launched.
Test Steps (Steps): Enable screen reader and open the app ~ Guest entry screen is announced by the screen reader
Navigate to the 'Continue as Guest' button using the screen reader ~ Button is announced with a meaningful label
Activate the button via screen reader ~ App navigates to the Event List screen

Name: Seat map color coding is distinguishable without relying on color alone
Description: Verify that available, booked, and selected seat states are distinguishable by more than color (e.g., shape, label, or pattern) to support color-blind users.
Preconditions: Guest is on the Seat Selection screen.
Test Steps (Steps): View the seat map ~ Available, booked, and selected seats are displayed
Verify each state uses a visual differentiator beyond color (e.g., icon, pattern, or label) ~ States are distinguishable without relying solely on color
Simulate color-blind view (e.g., greyscale mode) ~ All three seat states remain visually distinct

Name: App layout adapts correctly on different screen sizes
Description: Verify that the event catalog, seat map, and payment screens render correctly on small and large phone screen sizes without truncation or overflow.
Preconditions: App is installed on devices with varying screen sizes (small ~4.7" and large ~6.7").
Test Steps (Steps): Open the app on a small screen device ~ Guest entry screen renders without truncation
Navigate to the Event List ~ All event cards are fully visible and scrollable
Navigate to Seat Selection ~ Seat map is fully visible; no seats are clipped
Open the app on a large screen device ~ All screens render correctly with no excessive whitespace or misalignment

Name: App functions correctly on both Android and iOS
Description: Verify that the complete booking flow works on both Android and iOS platforms without platform-specific errors.
Preconditions: App is installed on an Android device and an iOS device.
Test Steps (Steps): On Android: complete the full flow from guest entry through booking confirmation ~ All screens render and function correctly
On iOS: complete the full flow from guest entry through booking confirmation ~ All screens render and function correctly
Compare behavior between platforms ~ No platform-specific UI or functional discrepancies

Name: Booking confirmation number is unique per booking
Description: Verify that each completed booking receives a distinct confirmation number.
Preconditions: Guest has completed at least two bookings in the current session.
Test Steps (Steps): Complete Booking 1 and note the confirmation number ~ Confirmation number is displayed
Complete Booking 2 and note the confirmation number ~ Confirmation number is displayed
Compare the two confirmation numbers ~ The two numbers are different

Name: Booking confirmation matches selected seats and price
Description: Verify that the Booking Confirmation screen accurately reflects the seats selected and the final price paid, including any discount.
Preconditions: Guest has just completed a booking with a known set of seats and an applied discount code.
Test Steps (Steps): View the Booking Confirmation screen ~ Confirmation is displayed
Verify each seat selected during Seat Selection appears on the confirmation ~ All seats are listed with correct tier
Verify the final price paid matches the total shown on the Payment screen ~ Price is consistent
Verify the event name matches the event booked ~ Correct event is shown

Name: Out-of-scope features are not accessible in the app
Description: Verify that account creation, login, booking cancellation, free-text search, and real payment fields are not present in the app.
Preconditions: Guest is in a fresh session.
Test Steps (Steps): Navigate through all screens ~ No sign-in, register, or account creation option is present
Check the Event List screen ~ No free-text search field is present; only category filter chips
Check the Payment screen ~ No card number, CVV, or billing address fields are present
Check My Bookings ~ No cancel or edit booking option is present on any booking entry
